clips.send: A friend stuck overthinking every 'how' sends this in relief that the how was never their job.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says most people never get what they want because they get stuck trying to figure out how it will happen before they even start.

His rule: write down exactly what you want, with real specifics, and stop there. You don't have to know how the money shows up, how the deal comes together, or how the door opens. That part isn't your job.

The universe will give me the how? What does that even mean? It means stop asking the question that's keeping you stuck.
